;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Spillover of the [[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**Twenty civilians are killed after [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] militants and the allied terror group [[Ansar al-Sunna (Mozambique)|Ansar al-Sunna]] attack a village in [[Mtwara]], [[Tanzania]]. Properties are damaged, forcing scores of people to abandon their homes. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/20-dead-as-terrorists-storm-tanzania-border-region/2015299# (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] announces that they have secured the release of Mikael Gidada and Sandra Loli, two [[Americans]] that have been held [[hostage]] by [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] rebels in [[Yemen]] for 16 months. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/10/14/us/politics/houthi-american-hostages.html (''The New York Times'')]
**A Houthi spokesman says 240 of their fighters have been released. In September, the [[United Nations]] announced a swap of "1081 conflict-related prisoners". [https://www.startribune.com/2-us-citizens-released-by-iran-backed-militants-in-yemen/572741511/ (AP via ''Star Tribune'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Linfa (2020)|Tropical Storm Linfa]]
***[[National Assembly (Vietnam)|Member of Vietnamese National Assembly]] [[Vietnamese military ranks and insignia|Major General]] Deputy commander of the [[4th Military Region (Vietnam People's Army)|4th Military Region of Vietnam People's Army]] {{ill|Nguyễn Văn Man|vi|Nguyễn Văn Man}} is confirmed to be missing. He was among the rescue troops dispatched to the mountainous area of [[Phong Điền District, Thừa Thiên-Huế Province]] to deal with the aftermath of Tropical Storm Linfa. [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/four-workers-confirmed-dead-in-hydropower-plant-landslide-4176454.html (VnExpress)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland]]
*****[[First Minister of Northern Ireland|First Minister]] [[Arlene Foster]] announces a "circuit breaker" lockdown in [[Northern Ireland]] effective October 16. Pubs and restaurants will have to shut down for four weeks unless they offer a takeaway service, and schools will close for two weeks until November 2. Meanwhile, places of worship, shops, and gyms can stay open. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-54533643 (BBC News)] [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-northern-ireland-imposes-four-week-circuit-breaker-lockdown-12103735 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****The number of new cases in [[Russia]] reaches 14,231 in the past 24 hours, a new record for the sixth day in a row. It is the first time that the country has reported more than 14,000 cases in a single day as authorities grapple with a second wave that has pushed hospitals to near-capacity. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/10/14/russias-new-coronavirus-cases-cross-14k-in-new-one-day-record-a71745 (''The Moscow Times'')]
****[[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] announces that the country has approved its second [[COVID-19 vaccine]] following preliminary trials. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-vaccine/russia-approves-second-covid-19-vaccine-after-preliminary-trials-idUSKBN26Z1T3 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports 2,072 new daily cases, its highest daily increase yet, bringing the cumulative count to 91,193 confirmed cases. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/226_DGS_boletim_20201014.pdf (DGS)]
****[[Prime Minister of Portugal|Prime Minister]] [[António Costa]] announces the reinstatement of the "state of calamity" effective at midnight tonight. Gatherings will be limited to five people. Weddings and baptisms can be attended by a maximum of 50, but university parties will be banned. Fines for businesses not complying with the rules will be doubled from an upper limit of 5,000 to 10,000 euros. [https://www.politico.eu/article/portugal-tightens-coronavirus-measures-with-new-state-of-calamity/ (''Politico'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Croatia]]
****[[Croatia]] reports 748 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest number in a single day since the [[pandemic]] began. [https://www.total-croatia-news.com/news/47372-croatia-reports-record-748-new-coronavirus-cases-4-deaths-in-last-24-hours (Total Croatia News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces a 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time curfew for the [[Île-de-France]] region that includes [[Paris]], as well as [[Grenoble]], [[Lille]], [[Lyon]], [[Marseille]], [[Montpellier]], [[Rouen]], [[Saint-Étienne]], and [[Toulouse]] starting October 17 for at least four weeks in an attempt to curb the spread of COVID-19 as the country declares another national [[State of emergency|state of health emergency]] after it expired on July 10. [https://amp.rte.ie/amp/1171582/ (RTÉ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports 5,132 new cases in the last 24 hours, the highest number of reported cases in a single day since April 5, according to official figures from the [[Robert Koch Institute]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/covid-19-germany-sees-6-month-record-in-daily-infections/2005775 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****The [[Government of the Republic of Ireland|government]] announces a nationwide ban on visits to homes or gardens in almost all circumstances, except for providing care to children or elderly and vulnerable people. It also announces that [[County Cavan|Cavan]], [[County Monaghan|Monaghan]], and [[County Donegal|Donegal]], which [[Republic of Ireland-United Kingdom border|border]] Northern Ireland, will move to Level 4 restrictions between midnight tomorrow until November 10, which means that non-essential retail stores will close and that all non-essential workers will work from home. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/nationwide-ban-on-home-visits-and-move-to-level-4-for-cavan-monaghan-donegal-is-announced-1.4380616 (''The Irish Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] registers 7,332 new cases in the last 24 hours, a new record for a single day since the pandemic began and surpassing the previous record of 6,557 cases that reported in March, when the country was still in [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in Italy|lockdown]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/italy-coronavirus-cases-surge-to-new-daily-record-above-7000-2 (''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports a record 6,526 new infections and 116 deaths in a single day, the highest since the beginning of the pandemic, as doctors warn that the healthcare system in the country is becoming overloaded. [https://de.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-poland-record/poland-reports-record-daily-spike-in-coronavirus-cases-and-deaths-idUSL8N2H51TC (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Liechtenstein]]
****[[Switzerland]] reports 2,823 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest record number in a single day since the pandemic began, thus taking the total to 68,704 confirmed cases in Switzerland and [[Liechtenstein]]. [https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-pmn/swiss-report-2823-new-coronavirus-cases (''Financial Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****The Catalan acting government announces the closure of bars, restaurants, beauty salons, and theme parks; the government also reduces the capacity in shops to 30% and 50% in gyms, cultural centers, and religious spaces for 15 days. [https://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2020/10/14/5f86f6f8fc6c83db258b460c.html (''El Mundo'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Iran]] announces temporary travel restrictions on [[Tehran]], [[Karaj]], [[Mashhad]], [[Isfahan]], and [[Urmia]], which includes banning travel to and from the five major cities in the country. It comes after Iran reports single-day records in both deaths and new infections, with 279 deaths and 4,830 new cases reported in the past 24 hours. [https://www.france24.com/en/20201014-iran-hits-new-virus-records-curbs-travel (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq]]
****[[Iraq]] surpasses 10,000 COVID-19 deaths. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/10/14/Coronavirus-Iraq-says-COVID-19-claimed-over-10-000-lives (Al-Arabiya)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Venezuela]] is expected to start [[clinical trial]]s for [[Russia]]'s [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://tass.com/society/1212351 (TASS)]

;International relations
*[[Kashmir conflict]], [[2019–2020 Jammu and Kashmir lockdown|Kashmir lockdown]]
**Former [[List of chief ministers of Jammu and Kashmir|chief minister]] of [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Indian-administered Kashmir]], [[Mehbooba Mufti]], has been released by [[India]]. She was detained on 5 August last year, when the government [[Revocation of the special status of Jammu and Kashmir|stripped the region of its partial autonomy]]. She was in house arrest under a [[Jammu and Kashmir Public Safety Act, 1978|controversial law]] that allows [[detention without charge]] for up to two years. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-54534500 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[George Floyd protests]], [[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]]
**[[Kenosha unrest]]
***It is announced that Kyle Rittenhouse, the teenager charged for killing two protesters in [[Kenosha, Wisconsin]], will not face gun charges in [[Illinois]]. [https://www.pennlive.com/nation-world/2020/10/teen-accused-in-protest-shootings-will-not-face-gun-charges-in-illinois-prosecutors.html (''The Patriot-News'')]
*[[Omnibus Law on Job Creation|Indonesian Omnibus Law on Job Creation]]
**[[People's Representative Council]] has submitted the final draft of Job Creation Law, which contains 812 pages after many revisions to [[President of Indonesia|President]] [[Joko Widodo]], which represented by [[Ministry of State Secretariat (Indonesia)|Minister of State Secretary]] [[Pratikno]]. [https://nasional.kompas.com/read/2020/10/14/14400961/jokowi-terima-draf-final-uu-cipta-kerja-dari-dpr-lewat-mensesneg (''Kompas'')]
*[[Uganda]]n security forces raid the offices of the [[National Unity Platform]] in [[Kampala]] and arrest several people, including opposition leader and presidential candidate [[Robert Kyagulanyi Ssentamu]], allegedly for illegally housing [[Uganda People's Defence Force|army]] uniforms. Signatures to get Ssentamu on the ballot and his 1campaign materials were also seized. [https://www.dw.com/en/uganda-security-forces-raid-office-of-presidential-hopeful-bobi-wine/a-55279396 (DW)]
*Protesters gather outside the [[Supreme Court of Israel|Israel Supreme Court]] and call for [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] to be investigated for a scandal surrounding a [[United States dollar|$]]2 billion submarine deal with [[Germany]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/courts_law/israeli-protesters-call-for-new-investigation-of-netanyahu/2020/10/14/f13fd918-0e50-11eb-b404-8d1e675ec701_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Biden–Ukraine conspiracy theory]], [[Conspiracy theories related to the Trump–Ukraine scandal]]
**The ''[[New York Post]]'' reports that newly uncovered emails suggest [[Hunter Biden]] introduced his father, then-[[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]], to a top executive at [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] natural gas firm [[Burisma|Burisma Holdings]]. The Post obtained the alleged emails from top [[Donald Trump]] adviser [[Rudy Giuliani]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/biden-camp-hits-back-at-hunter-biden-email-report-suggesting-then-vp-met-with-burisma-exec (Fox News)] [https://nypost.com/2020/10/14/email-reveals-how-hunter-biden-introduced-ukrainian-biz-man-to-dad/ (''NY Post'')] [https://nymag.com/intelligencer/2020/10/biden-emails-burisma-rudy-giulliani-russian-hackers-ukraine-new-york-post.html (''NY Magazine'')]
**[[Twitter]] and [[Facebook]] announce they are limiting the distribution of the article until it is fact-checked. [https://www.cnet.com/news/facebook-twitter-limit-reach-of-new-york-post-article-about-hunter-biden/ (CNET)] [https://www.realclearpolitics.com/video/2020/10/14/facebook_and_twitter_censor_new_york_post_potentially_harmful_story_on_hunter_biden.html  (RealClearPolitics)]

;Science and technology 
*[[Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[YouTube]] announces that it will ban misinformation about COVID-19 vaccines as an effort to expand its policy surrounding misinformation about COVID-19. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/520974-youtube-bans-covid-19-vaccine-misinformation (''The Hill'')] 

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[2020 NFL season]]
***The [[National Football League]] announces that the upcoming [[2021 Pro Bowl|Pro Bowl]] will be cancelled, the first time since 1949. However, the league announced that it would still name teams at the end of the season in the usual format through votes by fans, players, and coaches. [https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/30115592/nfl-cancels-pro-bowl-first-1949 (ESPN)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/2020/10/14/nfl-cancels-pro-bowl-covid-19-2022-game-las-vegas/3655011001/ (''USA Today'')]
**[[Alabama Crimson Tide football]] coach [[Nick Saban]] and athletic director [[Greg Byrne (athletic director)|Greg Byrne]] both test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.espn.com/college-football/story/_/id/30116627/alabama-football-coach-nick-saban-athletic-director-greg-byrne-test-positive-covid-19 (ESPN)]
